projected_lithology.description_bg: Почвен слой кафяв, глинесто-песъчлив; жълтеникави слабопесъчливи глини, на места прослоени от пясъци.
Редуване на мергели и глинести варовици; в долната част се очакват варовици, различно глинести.
Сиви микрокристалинни и тъмносиви неравномерно глинести варовици.
Варовици, глинести с преход в мергели; алевролити с прослойки аргилити и аргилити, на места слабо варовити.

records.next_research_task: Find post-drilling lithological/geophysical interpretation for E-72 or another primary source confirming actual penetrated intervals.

records.note: Annex 1 provides sampled depths/materials, not continuous exact contacts between every sample point.

records.known_context: Structural borehole reaching Triassic; mentioned in official EIA.

documented_groups.regional_borehole_lithology: Reddish sandstones of variable grain size, locally muddy, interbedded with siltstones and argillites. Alexandrovska Formation consists of alternating siltstones, sandstones and argillites.
Predominantly carbonate succession including limestones, dolomites, siltstones, argillites, sandstones and anhydrite interbeds in the Kozloduy area.
Unequal alternation of sandstones of different grain size, dark-brown to reddish siltstones/aleurolites, with isolated thin limestone and dolomite beds.
documented_groups.note: The EIA reports 81 m specifically for R-13 Kozloduy; this value must not be assigned to R-10.

triassic_borehole_context.interpretation_limit: Group descriptions are based collectively on R-10, R-12 and R-13 and regional drilling. They are not continuous depth intervals for R-10.

records.known_context: Verified deep structural borehole. Published secondary scientific sources document real lithostratigraphic information. R-12 Kozlodui is the holostratotype of the Upper Triassic Kozlodui Formation at 2762-3568 m. Published Lower Cretaceous work also describes real lithology from R-12, dominated in the cited unit by grey to light-grey massive micritic limestones with thin marly interbeds locally present. The complete primary borehole log has not yet been located.
